steps.title: We assess your property
steps.text: We look at the size of your space, your preferences and your budget to find the right air conditioning system for you.

steps.title: We recommend options
steps.text: We walk you through each unit's energy efficiency, cooling capacity and cost.

steps.title: We install the system
steps.text: Our technicians install with minimal disruption to your day and leave your space as clean as we found it.

steps.title: We stay available afterward
steps.text: Our team answers your questions after installation and offers maintenance plans to keep the system running smoothly.

reviews.author: Todd Hanson
reviews.text: Really professional and dependable company. We have used a lot of contractors over 40 years in construction, but this group is outstanding. This is a real review. I only leave reviews when I mean what I say. Very honest, capable and professional.

reviews.author: Andy McAvin
reviews.text: I had several estimates before I reached out to Otis, and they both told me I needed to completely redo my ductwork (witch was going to cost a lot!). Otis, on the other hand, was able to repair the existing ducts, and they did it in short order for a fraction of the cost. They also repaired my AC fan motor for a reasonable price which is important because im a pensioner). These guys were first rate!

about.title: A family company since 1986
text: Otis Heating & Air Conditioning was founded in 1986 by Paul Otis, and it is still family owned and operated.
Kris Otis is our owner and operator, and our motto is honest work for honest pay.
We work with all major brands, for homeowners, businesses, and owners of mobile and modular homes in and around Crosby.
